items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: If Reed come, let's, we don't worry about Reed. But give it to, if you don't come, long, good time, but I don't worry about him.

ctx.x: Let me ask you a question. Have you four ever played together at the same time? Oh, yeah. I mean, all at once. Have you had a lot of we four set together? Yeah. In the same? Oh, yeah. For sure. Good. You know, when you take four people, the chances are only one in 16, and you could ever roll four been together.

Well, listen. Well, listen. Listen. One thing. You know what I do with him? If the planet player, the center for him player, we got, if he's sick, listen, if the band, we got to start to play. Mean will take it. Listen. He got, we'll take it and play the job. We got a drummer set aside and then there. We gonna play. He got to take his coach. We got a good piano player. All right. We got, do we do, do we do that? Do we play? That's right. If Reed come, let's, we don't worry about Reed. But give it to, if you don't…

Yeah. One Saturday evening. Remember this, you and Precian, Emma and myself. For sure. Because of piano, a drum, cornet and trombone. We did a television show. Played all them numbers. WDSU, a show, played them. Four-piece band. I hope you realize it's, it's, when you take any four people, the chances of them ever getting together is 1-16. Yeah.
